title: Sidecar narration push stalls unsubmitted in orch pane on pane-not-idle fallback
description: When pane %0 is not idle at send-keys time, sendKeysVerified's idle-gate times out and the sendOnceUnverified fallback dumps the text into the orchestrator's input WITHOUT an effective Enter, so the [cam] narration line sits unsubmitted until the operator manually presses Enter. Observed live 2026-07-23 on the plan-escalated push for CAM-398: the operator had to intervene or the loop would have sat idle forever. This is a live recurrence of the CAM-375/CAM-364/CAM-404 UNDELIVERED send-once class. The fallback should either retry until the pane goes idle instead of dumping unverified text, or guarantee submission; a stalled narration breaks the autonomous loop because the orchestrator never observes the terminal.
